name: mirage
text: Done on the engine just now: parlay fair-odds age limit 5 -> 10 min and max legs 4 -> 5. Margin, stake caps ($12/$35/$50) and the $20 daily loss stop are unchanged, so the downside is bounded. Together with the coverage fix from earlier, that opens up the 'fair too old', 'too many legs' and 'no fair line' skips. Next, once enough RFQs have come in, I'll check quotes sent vs won and whether a lower margin wins more without losing money.
